title: MeasureReport_Population
description: The MeasureReport resource contains the results of the calculation of a measure; and optionally a reference to the resources involved in that calculation.

modifierExtension.description:

count.description: The number of members of the population.

subjectResults.description: This element refers to a List of subject level MeasureReport resources, one for each subject in this population.
